## Series

**Tessell · Crystal GUI** — A retained-mode declarative GUI framework: self-drawn rendering, isolated UI context, zero-allocation steady-state frames.

[tessell](https://github.com/ShiningRay/tessell) · [tessell-sheet-demo](https://github.com/ShiningRay/tessell-sheet-demo) · [tessell-stock-demo](https://github.com/ShiningRay/tessell-stock-demo)

**Citrine · Ruby reactive UI** — Signal-driven Ruby UI: the same components run in the browser via Opal and as native windows via libui / GTK.

[citrine](https://github.com/ShiningRay/citrine) · [beryl](https://github.com/ShiningRay/beryl) · [emerald](https://github.com/ShiningRay/emerald) · [emerald-zui](https://github.com/ShiningRay/emerald-zui) · [emerald-calc](https://github.com/ShiningRay/emerald-calc) · [citrine-stream](https://github.com/ShiningRay/citrine-stream) · [citrine-sheets](https://github.com/ShiningRay/citrine-sheets) · [citrine-remote](https://github.com/ShiningRay/citrine-remote) · [citrine-market-terminal](https://github.com/ShiningRay/citrine-market-terminal) · [citrine-native](https://github.com/ShiningRay/citrine-native) · [citrine-native-libui](https://github.com/ShiningRay/citrine-native-libui) · [citrine-native-gtk](https://github.com/ShiningRay/citrine-native-gtk) · [citrine-devtools](https://github.com/ShiningRay/citrine-devtools)

**Vela · Desktop app platform** — A Solid + TypeScript + Tauri 2 desktop platform: package format, marketplace, sample apps.

[vela](https://github.com/ShiningRay/vela) · [vela-apps](https://github.com/ShiningRay/vela-apps) · [vela-marketplace](https://github.com/ShiningRay/vela-marketplace)

**Ruby runtime & tooling** — Embedding Ruby in other languages, installing gems faster, using JSON as a database.

[mrb.cr](https://github.com/ShiningRay/mrb.cr) · [zruby](https://github.com/ShiningRay/zruby) · [gemvault](https://github.com/ShiningRay/gemvault) · [celerite](https://github.com/ShiningRay/celerite) · [jsondb-rb](https://github.com/ShiningRay/jsondb-rb) · [turbo_store](https://github.com/ShiningRay/turbo_store) · [redis-exchange](https://github.com/ShiningRay/redis-exchange) · [turbo-store-demo](https://github.com/ShiningRay/turbo-store-demo)

**Blockchain & trading** — Matching engines, JSON-RPC proxies, Riva speech proxy, BCS serialization, on-chain contracts.

[ethproxy](https://github.com/ShiningRay/ethproxy) · [exchange-nodejs](https://github.com/ShiningRay/exchange-nodejs) · [riva-proxy-rb](https://github.com/ShiningRay/riva-proxy-rb) · [riva-proxy-go](https://github.com/ShiningRay/riva-proxy-go) · [bcs-ruby](https://github.com/ShiningRay/bcs-ruby) · [grpc-ws-bridge](https://github.com/ShiningRay/grpc-ws-bridge) · [artela-throttle-aspect](https://github.com/ShiningRay/artela-throttle-aspect) · [patents](https://github.com/ShiningRay/patents) · [account_service-client](https://github.com/ShiningRay/account_service-client)
